extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit organizations and community partners in southwestern Pennsylvania seeking foundation grants
extracted.subtask_description: Heinz Endowments' public statement of grantmaking priorities, regional/geographic focus, program areas, and expectations for evaluation, learning, and impact that prospective grantees should align with.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund nonprofits, bridge divides and share what works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Endowments explicitly funds nonprofit organizations and expects funded work to contribute to shared learning — i.e., bridging divides and disseminating effective practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional/geographic focus
rubrics_metrics.description: southwestern Pennsylvania has the drive and wisdom to shape our nation's future. ... maximize impact for our region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation grounds its strategies in the southwestern Pennsylvania region (examples mention grants spanning 10 counties). Prospective projects should be regionally focused or demonstrate impact for the region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Arts & Culture; Civic Participation; Climate, Environment & Health; Community & Economic Development; Food Systems; Veterans; Workforce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These named areas represent the Endowments' primary funding/strategy domains; proposals aligned to one or more of these areas are most relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact orientation (possibilities, critical need, transformative change)
rubrics_metrics.description: The impact of our grants lies in the possibilities they create, the critical need they address and the transformative change they help to bring about.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding decisions are guided by whether a proposal creates new possibilities, addresses a clear critical need, and contributes to transformative change consistent with the Endowments' mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning orientation and evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: At the Endowments, we approach every partnership with a learning orientation. Through evaluation, we generate insights to inform our work and contribute to related fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantee relationships are treated as learning partnerships; proposals should include evaluation plans and commit to generating and sharing insights that inform both the project and broader practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of diverse data sources and context-specific strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: We use a wide range of data sources to monitor a continuously changing world so that our strategies are context specific and maximize impact for our region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should employ appropriate and varied data sources to justify context-specific approaches and to demonstrate how strategies will be adapted to local conditions to maximize regional impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative evaluation design and adaptive implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with our grantee partners to design evaluation and learning plans that position us to meaningfully adapt through implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Endowments expects collaborative design of evaluation/learning plans and an openness to adapt activities during implementation based on evidence and learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-of-grant analysis and continual improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: We hold space to purposefully analyze and reflect on outcomes at the close of grant cycles, reinforcing a culture of learning and continual improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees should plan for intentional end-of-project reflection and reporting that feeds back into organizational learning and potential future work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on youth employment and workforce development (example priority)
rubrics_metrics.description: With an increased focus on boosting employment options for the youngest members of the southwestern Pennsylvania workforce, the Endowments has awarded grants to organizations helping young people on paths to life-sustaining careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workforce proposals (e.g., pre-apprenticeship, long-term research into employment pathways) that target young people and span the region are highlighted as a funding priority in practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectation to share results and replicate 'what works'
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund nonprofits, bridge divides and share what works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond project implementation, the Endowments values dissemination of successful approaches and learning so effective practices can be shared and potentially scaled.
